author: Russell Brand
description:
What happens to a man when everything he was told turns out to be a lie? Russell Brand is asking the question most people are too afraid to say out loud — whether the chaos, the contradictions, and the constant manipulation have made genuine trust in any institution completely impossible. From a pandemic that may have originated in a lab, to injections pushed with the language of love, to the political forces that dressed up economic wars as moral crusades, the pattern keeps repeating itself. The people in power invoke children, invoke compassion, invoke emergency — and then you look at their bank accounts and something stops adding up. Russell isn't just cynical. He's paying attention.

Few stories have done more damage to public trust in modern Britain than the grooming gangs scandal. The crimes themselves are horrifying enough, but the deeper question is why so many warnings were ignored, why so many institutions appeared unwilling to act, and why accountability remains such a contentious issue years later. As new reports and investigations emerge, many people feel they are confronting not just criminality, but a profound failure of the authorities charged with protecting vulnerable children.

title: Most Disturbing Report In British History...

author: Russell Brand
description:
Something is deeply wrong in Britain, and Henry Nowak's death has just made it impossible to ignore. People are already drawing comparisons to George Floyd because when a young man dies and the system that was supposed to protect him looks the other way, the question everybody is asking is whether the police were ever really there to serve the public at all. What is becoming clear is that the UK's policing apparatus has been quietly reoriented around a particular agenda, one where the race and identity of a victim determines the urgency of the response. Henry Nowak's death isn't just a tragedy. It is a reckoning. Something has been exposed, a balance has been broken, and the people of Britain are waking up to the reality that the force meant to protect and serve has become a force built to control.
